newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA'S MURALITHARAN OUT OF SECOND TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA'S MURALITHARAN OUT OF SECOND TEST.

text.p: Muthiah Muralitharan, the only Sri Lankan bowler to have taken over 100 test wickets, has been ruled out of the second test against Pakistan because of injury.
Muralitharan has strained a muscle near his rib cage, team officials said. He has been replaced by off-spinner Ruwan Kalgape in the 14-strong squad for the test starting on Saturday.
Another casualty is left-arm fast-medium bowler Nuwan Zoysa. He has pulled a thigh muscle and has been replaced by Sajeeva de Silva.

Squad: Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Aravinda de Silva, Sanath Jayasuriya, Russell Arnold, Marvan Atapattu, Hashan Tillekeratne, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Chaminda Vaas, Jayantha Silva, Sajeeva de Silva, Ruwan Kalpage, Kumar Dharmasena, Sanjeeva Ranatunga, Dulip Liyanage.
